<?php
class Base161Review {
    protected static function requiredBase($one, $two) { echo "bad-base|"; }
    protected static function lineage() {
        echo self::class, "|", static::class, "|";
    }
}
$subject161Review = new class extends Base161Review {
    public static function requiredOwn($one, $two) { echo "bad-own|"; }
    public static function failNever(): never {
        echo "never|";
    }
    private static function effect($text) { echo $text; return 1; }
    public static function probe() {
        parent::lineage();
        try {
            self::requiredOwn(self::effect("own-arg|"));
        } catch (ArgumentCountError $caught161Review) {
            echo $caught161Review->getMessage(), "|", $caught161Review->getLine(), "|";
        }
        try {
            parent::requiredBase(self::effect("base-arg|"));
        } catch (ArgumentCountError $caught161Review) {
            echo $caught161Review->getMessage(), "|", $caught161Review->getLine(), "|";
        }
        try {
            self::failNever();
        } catch (TypeError $caught161Review) {
            echo $caught161Review->getMessage(), "|", $caught161Review->getLine(), "|";
        }
    }
};
$subject161Review::probe();
echo "after";

<?php
function rebind161Author(): int {
    global $object161Author;
    echo "arg|";
    $object161Author = null;
    echo "rebound|";
    return 1;
}
$value161Author = 3;
$object161Author = new class {
    public static function update161Author(int &$value, int $delta = 4): int {
        $value += $delta;
        return $value;
    }

};
echo $object161Author->update161Author($value161Author, delta: 2), "|", $value161Author, "|";
echo $object161Author::update161Author($value161Author), "|", $value161Author, "|";

<?php
